title: IT/ITES Intern – Web Application Development
description:
Shinrai Systems Private Limited is an IT and technology company focused on software development, web applications, modern digital solutions, and technology integration.

We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated IT/ITES interns who want to develop their technical skills by contributing to real-world web application projects under appropriate guidance and supervision.

This internship offers an opportunity to learn modern development practices, work with contemporary UI/UX designs, understand real project workflows, and build practical experience in software development.

Internship Overview

The selected candidates will participate in the development and improvement of live web application projects. They will work on assigned development tasks, responsive interfaces, application features, testing, debugging, and other project-related activities based on their skills and learning progress.

The internship is suitable for students, fresh graduates, and aspiring developers who want to strengthen their practical knowledge of current web technologies.

Key Responsibilities

* Assist in developing and maintaining web applications.
* Convert UI/UX designs into responsive web pages.
* Work with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and modern frontend technologies.
* Learn and work with React.js or other relevant frameworks according to project requirements.
* Assist with backend development, APIs, and database integration where applicable.
* Understand application architecture, reusable components, and coding standards.
* Test web application features and help identify and fix bugs.
* Use Git and version control for project collaboration.
* Participate in code reviews, project discussions, and development planning.
* Follow project documentation, security practices, and quality standards.
* Complete assigned tasks within agreed timelines and communicate progress to the project team.

Technologies You May Work With

**Frontend:** HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React.js, responsive web design.

**UI/UX and Design:** Figma, modern interface design, design-to-code implementation, mobile-friendly layouts.

**Backend:** PHP, Node.js, REST APIs, or other technologies depending on the project.

**Database:** MySQL or other relevant databases.

**Tools:** Git, GitHub, browser developer tools, and development environments.

*The actual technology stack will depend on the assigned project and the intern's skills. Candidates are not expected to know every technology before joining.*

Eligibility Criteria

* Students currently pursuing or recently graduated from BCA, MCA, B.Tech, BE, B.Sc. IT, M.Sc. IT, Diploma in Computer Engineering, or a related field are encouraged to apply.
* Candidates with practical web development knowledge or personal projects will be preferred.
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is desirable.
* Familiarity with React.js, PHP, Node.js, databases, Git, or Figma is an advantage.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and development practices.
* Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to communicate clearly and work collaboratively.
* Commitment to the complete three-month internship.

Freshers and beginners with a strong interest in web development are welcome.

Mandatory Laptop Requirement

Candidates must have their own working laptop for development and project-related activities.

The company will not provide a laptop for this internship. Candidates should ensure that their laptop can run the required development tools and software.

Internship Details

* Duration: Six months.
* Stipend: later Based on Performance.
* Internship certificate: Yes.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should submit their updated resume through .

info@shinraisystems.com

Work Location: In person

title: ReactJS Team Lead
description:
Lead a team of front-end developers in delivering scalable and maintainable web applications using React.js.

Own the architecture and technical decisions for complex UI features and front-end systems.

Mentor team members, conduct code reviews, and enforce development best practices.

Translate product requirements into technical specifications and timelines.

Collaborate closely with backend engineers, designers, DevOps, and QA to ensure end-to-end delivery.

Drive performance optimization, cross-browser compatibility, and responsive design.

Manage task allocation, sprint planning, and ensure timely delivery of features.

Ensure a high standard of UI/UX consistency and quality across the product.

  
  

### **Requirements**

6+ years of hands-on experience with React.js, including Hooks, Context API, and Redux.

Strong foundation in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and SCSS/SASS.

Solid experience in designing component libraries, design systems, and atomic design structures.

Familiarity with Next.js, Server-Side Rendering (SSR), and static site generation.

Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and JSON data handling.

Experience working with Webpack, Babel, and front-end build optimization.

Expertise in unit testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library) and integration testing.

Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, code versioning tools like Git, and tools like ESLint, Prettier.

Experience deploying and scaling front-end applications on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

Bonus: Exposure to micro frontends, performance profiling tools, and A/B testing frameworks.
